description: Same-job paired runs of historical consecutive core revisions (the pairs the #143 absolute backtest judged), replayed by `npm run performance:budgets:backtest` (#303).
limitations: Each run built both sides from source in one job and measured them in six counterbalanced rounds (A B B A ...) of one core assessment invocation with two fresh-process samples each, so twelve samples per side per row.
Only the reduced samples are kept here; each run's raw invocation outputs are in its uploaded artifact (digest recorded).

Where an older candidate's accuracy corpus differs from the pinned one, the run fails the pinned acceptance-criteria step (suite:accuracy-corpus-identity-mismatch) after the paired measurement (runs 36179737305 and 36180553407); the timing evidence is unaffected.
One paired run per revision pair.
